name: Sakura Chihiro
source:
Zodiac Sign: Sagittarius
Musical Instrument: None
Hobbies: Growing herbs

The teacher who is in charge of Kazuki's class. Her department is Music Management, but she has also been an advisor to the gardening club.
Chihiro is a calm and gentle young woman, but she is also the airhead type.
She has a habit helping the students by giving love advices or helping out in the club activities. The students whom she assists, feel the joy and the purpose in life because of her desperate support. She will immediately consult any student who is asking her for an advice, because she has a kind and friendly personality. Due to her being so kind, her students endearingly call her "Sakura-chan".
Chihiro's ability to play musical instruments is weak.
She is growing herbs In the music preparation chamber instead of doing it in a laboratory.
Herbal tea is her favorite drink.
